notes:
Background: Sable Quay builds emergency dispatch contact centers for federal critical infrastructure partners. Must run inference inside customer boundary (air-gapped data centers) - zero egress allowed. Interested in replacing rule-based suggestion system with LLM-driven agent assist, live ticket summarization, and function/tool-calling into their ticketing + PBX (ServiceNow + proprietary SIP controller).

Key technical requirements (shorthand):
- Deployment: fully on_prem, air_gapped; no persistent outbound connections, cust-managed update USB/VM image pipeline.
- Security: FIPS-140 validated crypto, HSM/KMS integration, detailed audit logs, SSO via SAML + SCIM, ISO/SOC alignment.
- Models: prefer quantized open models with signed model artifacts (no external model pulls). Must support offline vetting & redaction pipeline before promotion.
- Performance: target suggestion latency <250ms p95 for agent-assist; ticket-summarization batch jobs ok at higher latency. Steady-state concurrency: ~500 concurrent agent sessions; expected spike scenarios up to 2,000 concurrent during incidents.
- Throughput/cost: cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated/Private if unit economics and HA covered. Look to Optimize for batching/caching to reduce GPU count.
- Integration: function calling to ServiceNow, telephony SIP actions, and internal case-metadata write-backs. Must support signed webhook/queue bridge inside network boundary.

POC plan (as discussed):
- Phase 0: NDA + architecture sign-off (in progress).
- Phase 1: 2-node on-prem inference cluster (certified hardware) air-gapped POC; run redwood private control plane stub inside isolated network; run agent-assist demo with synthetic traffic (week 1-3).
- Phase 2: Load/stress test to validate spikes to 2k concurrent with KV-cache & batching; measure p95 latencies and token costs (week 4).
- Phase 3: Security attestation + FIPS module validation; prepare SOW for production rollout.
